name: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines

flag.description: Three vertical bands of blue, gold and green, with the gold band twice as wide as the others and holding three green diamonds arranged in a V.
flag.symbolism: Blue represents the sky and sea, gold warmth and the islands' sands, and green the vegetation; the diamonds form a V for Vincent and are called the "Gems of the Antilles".

hook: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines sets three green diamonds in a V for Vincent on a wide gold band between blue and green.
trivia: The current design by Swiss artist Julien van der Wal replaced an earlier flag that showed a breadfruit leaf and the coat of arms.
Scenes from the "Pirates of the Caribbean" films were shot at Wallilabou Bay on Saint Vincent.
